round_variation.interpretation: descriptive run-order drift only; samples are clustered and no paired-significance claim is made

commands.dav1d: direct invocation of the supplied immutable C API helper with --corpus; no build wrapper is used
commands.go_test: project-env <frozen test binary> -test.run '^TestPublicDecoderFullClipCorpusSamples$' -test.count=1 -test.v with GOEXPERIMENT=simd GOMAXPROCS=1 GOGC=100

corpus_and_boundary.boundary_difference: Go NewDecoderFromIVF copies packet payloads during its timed constructor; C wraps preloaded packet slices without copying them. C still parses IVF frame records in the timed interval. This is a public-API comparison, not an isolated language/SIMD comparison.
corpus_and_boundary.corpus_provenance: not provided to this helper; do not infer source provenance
corpus_and_boundary.dav1d_timed_operation: parse IVF frame records from preloaded whole-file bytes + fresh single-thread dav1d context + wrap packet slices without copying + decode/drain/observe visible frame edges + unref pictures + close context
corpus_and_boundary.excluded_from_both: file reads, input SHA-256, sidecar reads, full-output MD5 preflight and result comparison; process startup
corpus_and_boundary.go_diagnostics: cold NewDecoder(payloads) excludes IVF parsing and packet copying; warm Reset+DecodeNext reuses one decoder. Both are reported but excluded from the primary ratio.
corpus_and_boundary.go_timed_operation: NewDecoderFromIVF(preloaded IVF bytes) + all DecodeNext calls + touch first/last visible byte of Y/U/V and dimensions + Close; timed constructor parses IVF and copies packet payloads

post_run_source_tree_observation.interpretation: post-run worktree observation only; not proof of which source built the supplied Go binary

publication_note.boundary: Go NewDecoderFromIVF copies packet payloads during the timed constructor. The C helper wraps packet slices from preloaded IVF bytes without copying; it still parses IVF frame records in the timed interval.
publication_note.comparison_caveat: Do not compare the 2.814x ratio with the older 2.823x snapshot as a causal performance change.
publication_note.primary_result: Combined 18-sample-per-clip medians: Go cold IVF 1601.0247695 ms; installed dav1d 1.5.3 568.8645 ms; ratio 2.814422009986561x.
publication_note.provenance: The installed dav1d runtime is version 1.5.3 and its dylib hash is recorded; installed binary/source-build provenance is unverified.
publication_note.validation: Both rounds match MD5 sidecars for all 18 clips / 864 visible frames.

sampling_protocol.aggregate_statistic: sum of the combined per-clip medians
sampling_protocol.combined_per_clip_statistic: median of 18 raw samples (mean of the two middle values)
sampling_protocol.interpretation: round samples are clustered by serialized run order; reversing order reveals but does not eliminate drift; no paired-significance claim
